# clickup.md — Configuration Reference

## Location

Place `clickup.md` at the **project root**.

```
project-root/
└── clickup.md     ← here
```

**Why root:**
- Committed to git — shared across machines and AI tools
- Any agent or tool that clones the repo can immediately find the config
- Visible and discoverable without knowing Claude-specific conventions

---

## Template

> `clickup.md` is created by Step 0B (one-time setup). Do not edit IDs manually.

```markdown
# ClickUp Configuration
# Generated by planning-clickup setup

## Required
space_id: ""         # auto-filled by Step 0B
space_name: ""       # e.g. "Smart-ITC"
folder_id: ""        # auto-filled by Step 0B
folder_name: ""      # e.g. "Projects"
list_id: ""          # auto-filled by Step 0B
list_name: ""        # e.g. "DigitalID"

## Optional
default_assignee_id: ""        # ClickUp user ID — leave blank to skip auto-assign
default_priority: "normal"     # urgent | high | normal | low
status_inprogress: "in progress"   # Exact status name used by this workspace
status_done: "complete"            # Exact status name used by this workspace
```

---

## Field Reference

### Required

| Field | Source | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `space_id` | auto (Step 0B) | Resolved by selecting space name |
| `space_name` | user picks | e.g. "Smart-ITC" |
| `folder_id` | auto (Step 0B) | Resolved by selecting folder name |
| `folder_name` | user picks | e.g. "Projects" |
| `list_id` | auto (Step 0B) | Resolved by selecting or creating a project |
| `list_name` | user picks | e.g. "DigitalID" |

### Optional

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `default_assignee_id` | string | _(none)_ | Auto-assign new tasks to this user ID. Leave blank to create unassigned tasks |
| `default_priority` | string | `normal` | Fallback priority when user doesn't specify urgency. One of: `urgent`, `high`, `normal`, `low` |
| `status_inprogress` | string | `in progress` | Exact status name for "work has started" — varies per workspace |
| `status_done` | string | `complete` | Exact status name for "work is finished" — varies per workspace |

---

## Setup Flow (Step 0B — one-time)

Runs only when `clickup.md` does not exist:

```
1. Call clickup_get_workspace_hierarchy (max_depth: 0)
   → show available spaces
   → ask: "Which space?"

2. Call clickup_get_workspace_hierarchy (space_ids: [chosen], max_depth: 1)
   → show folders inside the chosen space
   → ask: "Which folder holds your projects?"

3. Call clickup_get_folder (folder_id)
   → show lists (= projects) inside the folder
   → ask: "Which project does this task belong to?
      1. {{list_name_1}}
      2. {{list_name_2}}
      ...
      N. + Create new project"

   IF user picks existing → use its list_id
   IF user picks new project
     → ask project name → call clickup_create_list → use new list_id

4. (Optional) Ask: "Should I auto-assign tasks to you?"
   → If yes, call clickup_resolve_assignees → save default_assignee_id

5. (Optional) Ask: "What are the 'in progress' and 'done' status names?"

6. Write clickup.md with space, folder, list + optional values
   → Confirm: "Config saved → {{space_name}} > {{folder_name}} > {{list_name}}"
```

---

## Finding Status Names

Status names differ between workspaces. To find the correct names:

```
Option A: Ask the user — "What status names does your ClickUp workspace use for in-progress and done?"
Option B: Call clickup_get_list with the list_id → inspect the "statuses" field in the response
```

Common variations:

| Meaning | Common names |
|---|---|
| In Progress | `in progress`, `In Progress`, `doing`, `active` |
| Done | `complete`, `Complete`, `done`, `closed`, `Closed` |
